verdict.rationale: n8n's own docs include a "Use the command line" page under self-hosted configuration, and a probe confirms an official CLI is documented there, so a first-party CLI exists. The pack gives only the page title, though, so no commands, scope or agent-friendly behaviour are evidenced, and its placement under host configuration suggests an admin tool rather than one built for AI-native workflows. missing for 10: documented command set and capabilities (e.g. running or exporting workflows from the terminal), evidence of agent-oriented or scriptable output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
